parameters.description:
Relay a message to your own Zulip through the UnitySVC gateway by posting a native Zulip payload.

`zulip-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `zulip` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Zulip URL from your stored secrets, injects your `Authorization: Basic` credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `api_key_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding your base64 user:password for HTTP basic auth).

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's base64 user:password for HTTP basic auth
